title: Collective Causal Knowledge & Belief Revision
status_at_freeze: No E008 model gateway requests; existing offline/reference outcomes disclosed.

bounds.note: planning estimate, not observed usage or attested billing; limits require live-controller enforcement

model_identity_scope: Requested and provider-declared identity, not independent attestation of backend weights.
compatibility: Exactly one Responses tool-protocol smoke per available fixed model; one catalogue GET per role. No replay. Missing secondary is unavailable, no replacement.
transport_policy: Serial bounded requests; quota/time/space/STOP before every request. Only GET recovery after transient provider failures, delays30/120/300. Auth/TLS/invalid content/unknown orphan stop; no global TLS changes.

memory.selection: Calibration only: both C1/T1 identified-target accuracy in[.2,.8] preferred; then pooled absolute distance to.5; then smaller budget. Never optimize format contrast. If all outside band use same rule and report floor/ceiling.
memory.free_text: C1 deliberately ordinary text, not forced JSON.
memory.typed: T1 fixed human typed-v1 in frozen e008_protocol.py.
memory.model_developed: T2 allows UTF8/base64 machine-native payload; two independent lines, three versions each,12 validation worlds/version; best mean common-target Q score, earliest available tie. Failed proposals/validation retained; no human fallback or best-test-line selection.

analysis.unit: 60 heldout worlds,20/family; average two repeats and both T2 lines inside world.
analysis.target: Ten new Q, common ABC-identifiability target in every arm; correct null only if ABC unidentifiable. Assigned-information epistemic correctness separately.
analysis.test: Exact two-sided paired sign-flip, integer differences scaled40; symmetric null differences assumed.
analysis.multiplicity: Holm over all eight accuracy contrasts, alpha.05.

interval.method: paired world percentile bootstrap stratified by SCM family

analysis.failures: All assigned terminal failures/skips zero in main accuracy; never drop failed publication/reader. Pending/running is incomplete, not zero. No outcome-based repeat/replacement.

precision_assumptions.limitations: Normal approximation with Bonferroni worst-case critical value for Holm, not guaranteed power of exact sign-flips. SD assumptions are not pilot observations; questions and repeats do not increase n.

analysis.H1: All three C1-C0/C1-SINGLE-A/C1-SINGLE-B contrasts meet positive_rule AND C1 integrative mean>=.5 AND lower95>.25.
analysis.H2: Descriptive natural/injected premise and dependent revision separately, retained identity/SCM/provenance; actual observable opportunities as denominators, false corrections and missing/ineligible opportunities reported. No stand-alone confirmatory p-value.
analysis.H3: Primary T1-C1 meets positive_rule; whole protocol package effect, not isolated syntax causation.
analysis.H4: T2-T1 meets positive_rule; conditional on the two generated lines, not universal protocol invention.
analysis.H5: Descriptive paired control effects,12 fixed test worlds, C1/T1/T2 lines, deliberate falsehood/forged evidence/authentication ablation/actual crash after durable commit/cross-model D. Unavailable secondary retained as unavailable, not an effect estimate.

H6.favorable_descriptive_rule: primary accuracy contrast positive AND primary resource ratio upper95 < 1
H6.multiplicity: No additional resource p-values or confirmatory significance claims; all fixed contrasts/scenarios shown.
H6.scope: Operational measured resources, not currency, energy or total economic cost. Input+output token counts have equal unit weight, not equal monetary price.

resources.unknown: Never zero-fill failed/unknown usage; undefined bootstrap draw makes interval unavailable.
resources.setup: Charge both T2 lines, all proposals, versions, critics and validation; calibration,robustness,smoke,catalogue separate.

reference.disclosure: 90 cold finite-enumeration runs already completed before LLM preregistration;1440/1440 answers. This is an algorithmic feasibility ceiling, not an LLM or compute-matched control. No rerun or feedback to heldout participants.

audit_boundary: Engineering checks by the sole executor; independent SCM oracle and separate raw reconstruction, not external human review. Sealed evidence checked at batch boundaries and on actual archive consumption; no hostile concurrent host writer assumption.
reporting: Report every H1-H6, C1 historical audit, failures/contradictions, accuracy/abstention/confidence/provenance/false correction, all fixed resources and controls. No claim of consciousness, universal language, general collective intelligence or mandatory T2 success.
